dedupe_keys.name: low carbon london electric vehicle load profiles residential commercial and public charging trials uk power networks 2013 2014

description: This London Datastore dataset holds electric vehicle charging data from the Low Carbon London project delivered by UK Power Networks. It has three folders: raw data from the EV commercial trials of 2013 to 2014, ordered by customer with ten-minute time stamps of EV activity; lists of charging events from four suppliers of public charge points; and raw data from the EV residential trials of 2013 to 2014, also by customer at ten-minute resolution, together with anonymised surveys about EV habits. All data are anonymised. The single ZIP file of about 115 MB is available for free download under a Creative Commons Attribution licence, maintained by the Greater London Authority with UK Power Networks as author; the page shows the last update as more than four years ago. Coverage is London. Caveats: the trials are small, early-adopter samples from 2013 and 2014 and may not reflect current vehicles and charging behaviour. Simulation uses are residential, workplace and public EV charging profiles for distribution feeder load growth and flexibility studies. Related records: data-low-carbon-london-smart-meter-households holds the household smart meter data from the same project.
